vulnerability_type: Denial of Service via Restricted Mode

preconditions.description: Contract must be in Restricted state (bot protection enabled)
Attacker must have at least 1 wei of BNRG tokens to initiate a transfer

exploit_hint: When contract is in Restricted state, call transfer() with any amount to a victim address. This will update lastTx[attacker] and lastTx[victim] to current block timestamp. The victim will then be blocked from making transactions for 60 seconds due to the 'only one tx/min' restriction. Repeat with different victim addresses to block multiple users.
